geometry.comparison: Alternating paired warmed calls, synchronized wall time, resident CUDA inputs
geometry.gate: Fail if any paired 95% interval lies entirely above +2%; inspect all changes

graded-after.scope: Complete device-resident meshing, including domain/sizing refit, fresh sampling, progressive fitting, refinement, quality improvement and extraction. Setup, upload, download, validation and export are outside replay timing.
graded-after.quality_stage_diagnostic_scope: Child scratch can describe a rejected or skipped trial; published mesh validity is determined by the parent error/valid/counts.
